planning_assumptions: PRD says 'revamp the login screen' — interpreted as a modern visual redesign of both login and signup screens with improved styling, a branded header with the app name, better card layout, and polished form elements
Both Login.tsx and Signup.tsx share Login.css — changes to the CSS will affect both screens
The existing component structure (Login.tsx, Signup.tsx) and logic will be preserved; this is primarily a CSS/styling revamp with minor structural additions to the JSX
Previous attempts at this task failed — keeping scope focused on achievable CSS and minor JSX changes without introducing new dependencies

tasks.title: Revamp login and signup screen UI
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Redesign the login and signup screens with a modern, polished look — add a branded header area with the app name ('Crunchy Number Muncher') and a welcome message, improve card styling with better shadows and spacing, modernize form inputs with icons or refined styling, and add a gradient or colored accent to make the screens visually appealing. Both light and dark themes must be supported.

2. READ FIRST: Read these files before making changes:
   - src/components/Login.tsx (current login component)
   - src/components/Login.css (shared styles for login and signup)
   - src/components/Signup.tsx (signup component reuses Login.css classes)
   - src/components/Login.test.tsx (existing tests — do NOT break these)
   - src/components/Signup.test.tsx (existing tests — do NOT break these)
   - src/App.tsx (to understand app name and theme context)
   - src/App.css (for CSS variable definitions used in Login.css)

3. FILES TO MODIFY:
   - src/components/Login.css — Major restyle: modernize card with larger max-width (380-400px), add a branded header section above the form with gradient background and app name, improve input styling with better padding/border-radius, add subtle animations on focus, improve button styling with hover effects, ensure responsive design works on mobile.
   - src/components/Login.tsx — Add a branded header section above the form showing the app name ('Crunchy Number Muncher') and a short welcome message. Keep all existing form fields, error handling, and callback props intact. Do NOT change the component's public interface (props).
   - src/components/Signup.tsx — Add the same branded header section for visual consistency. Keep all existing form fields, error handling, and callback props intact.
   - src/components/Login.test.tsx — Update tests if any text content changes (e.g., if button labels change). Add a test verifying the branded header text is rendered.
   - src/components/Signup.test.tsx — Update tests similarly, add test for branded header.

4. APPROACH:
   - Use pure CSS only — no new dependencies.
   - Use the existing CSS custom properties (--app-bg, --calculator-bg, --display-bg, etc.) from App.css for theme compatibility.
   - Add a .login-header section with a gradient background using theme-aware colors.
   - Increase card max-width to ~400px for a more spacious feel.
   - Add subtle box-shadow transitions and input focus animations.
   - Ensure the 'Sign up' / 'Back to login' navigation links remain functional.
   - Keep all existing class names that tests rely on (login-input, login-submit, login-error, etc.).

5. PATTERNS: Follow the existing CSS variable pattern in App.css and Login.css. Match the border-radius (8-12px) and transition patterns already used.
acceptance_criteria: Login page displays the app name 'Crunchy Number Muncher' in a branded header section above the sign-in form
Login form still shows email field, password field, Login button, and Sign up link
Entering invalid credentials and clicking Login shows an error message on screen
Clicking 'Sign up' navigates to the signup screen which also shows the branded header

tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Run the full Vitest test suite to verify that the login screen revamp has not broken any existing functionality and that new tests pass.

2. READ FIRST: package.json for test script configuration.

3. Run: npx vitest run from the project root /home/eunomia/.eunomia/workspace/eunomia-mini-calculator

4. Verify all test files pass:
   - src/components/Login.test.tsx
   - src/components/Signup.test.tsx
   - src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
   - src/components/Button.test.tsx
   - src/components/Display.test.tsx
   - src/App.test.tsx
   - src/auth/credentialStore.test.ts

5. Also run: npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compilation.

6. If any tests fail, report the exact failure messages so the developer can fix them.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0 — all tests pass including new branded header tests
npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0 — no TypeScript errors
No test regressions in existing Login, Signup, Calculator, Button, or Display tests
